description.message: Track prices on Amazon, AliExpress, eBay, Etsy, ASOS and 30 more stores with TarifPing: recorded as you visit the page.

connectIntro.message: Connect the extension to your TarifPing account to track prices on these sites:

serverHint.message: Your TarifPing address (change only for a local test)

changed.message: Price change recorded, alert sent according to your settings.

noPrice.message: No price found on this page. Wait for it to finish loading or pick a variant, then reopen this window.

autoHint.message: The price is recorded automatically each time you visit this page (at most every 20 minutes).

limitReached.message: Limit of $1 pages reached: upgrade your plan in TarifPing.

reload.message: Reload the page to activate the extension on this tab.

openProduct.message: Open a product page on one of these sites:
